_comment: SYNTHETIC DEMO CASE. Every person, company and event here is fictional. Date tokens are offsets from the seed day (see okafor.json).
description: DEMO: Benbow, Harold - premises slip-and-fall (Ridgeway Fresh Market, Yonkers)

fields.name: Accident Location
fields.value: Ridgeway Fresh Market, 1100 Central Park Avenue, Yonkers, Westchester County, NY (produce aisle 3)

fields.name: Insurance Carrier
fields.value: Northgate Commercial Insurance, commercial general liability for Ridgeway Fresh Market, Inc.

fields.name: Case Summary
fields.value: Slipped on a wet floor in the produce aisle with no warning sign. Displaced right distal radius fracture, open reduction and internal fixation, months of hand therapy.

fields.name: Case Value Rationale
fields.value: Specials of $108,400.00 already exceed the $100,000 per occurrence limit. Surgical fracture with hardware in a 63 year old right-hand dominant retired machinist. A policy limits demand is the right move once the surgery center's itemized bill is in.

fields.name: Health Insurance or Lien Holder
fields.value: Empire Crest Health Plan lien, $31,250.00 asserted. Final lien letter not yet received.

fields.name: Treatment Status
fields.value: Discharged from hand therapy. Dr. Fairweather declared MMI with permanent loss of wrist extension.

fields.name: Liability Assessment
fields.value: Strong. Store incident report shows the aisle was mopped minutes before the fall and no wet floor sign was out.

notes.subject: Intake: fall at Ridgeway Fresh Market
notes.detail: Harold Benbow, 63, retired machinist. On {{-415}} at about 11:20 am he slipped in produce aisle 3 at Ridgeway Fresh Market in Yonkers and fell onto his outstretched right hand. He says the floor was wet and shiny and there was no yellow sign. A store employee helped him up and filled out an incident report. Taken by ambulance to St. Aldric Hospital. Right wrist fracture. Retainer and HIPAA authorizations signed.

notes.subject: Preservation letter
notes.detail: Sent a preservation letter to Ridgeway Fresh Market demanding the produce aisle video from {{-415}}, the incident report, the mopping and floor inspection logs, and the names of employees on shift.

notes.subject: Witness: Tomas Lerner
notes.detail: Spoke with Tomas Lerner, a customer who saw the fall. He says an employee had just mopped near the bananas and walked away with the bucket. He did not see any wet floor sign. Willing to give a statement.

notes.subject: Surgery
notes.detail: Dr. Naomi Fairweather performed open reduction and internal fixation of the right distal radius at Palisade Ambulatory Surgery Center. Volar plate and screws. Hand therapy to start in two weeks.

notes.subject: MMI and discharge
notes.detail: Dr. Fairweather's final visit note: maximum medical improvement reached. Permanent loss of about 25 degrees of wrist extension and reduced grip strength on the right. Hardware stays in unless symptomatic. Discharged from Ironleaf OT the same week.

notes.subject: Moving to demand: limits problem
notes.detail: Specials now total $108,400.00 against a $100,000 per occurrence limit that Northgate confirmed in writing. Plus the Empire Crest lien of $31,250.00. This is a policy limits demand case. Before we serve it we need the itemized bill with CPT codes from Palisade Ambulatory Surgery Center. All we have is their balance statement showing $58,000.00.

notes.subject: Palisade still has not sent the itemized bill
notes.detail: Called Palisade billing again. They say the itemized statement is in the queue. This is the only thing holding up the demand. Also asked Harold about any excess or umbrella policy the store might have; Northgate's letter only mentions the primary policy.

emails.subject: Ridgeway Fresh Market claim: letter of representation
emails.body: We represent Harold Benbow for injuries sustained in a fall at your insured's store on {{-415}}. Please direct all communication to this office and confirm the limits of all applicable policies, including any excess or umbrella coverage.

emails.subject: RE: Ridgeway Fresh Market claim
emails.body: Claim NCI-GL-0047719 is assigned to me. The commercial general liability policy carries limits of $100,000 per occurrence and $200,000 aggregate. A declarations page is enclosed. Kendra Volk, Senior Claims Specialist.

emails.subject: Store incident report and video
emails.body: Enclosed is the store incident report. The store advises that surveillance video of aisle 3 for that date was overwritten under its 30 day retention policy. Kendra Volk.

emails.subject: Lien amount
emails.body: Empire Crest Health Plan asserts a lien in the amount of $31,250.00 for accident related claims paid on behalf of Harold Benbow. This amount is subject to change. A final lien letter will be issued upon notice of settlement.

emails.subject: Itemized bill request
emails.body: Please send the itemized bill with CPT codes and dates of service for Harold Benbow. We have only the balance statement showing $58,000.00. HIPAA authorization attached.

emails.subject: RE: Itemized bill request
emails.body: Your request has been received and forwarded to our billing vendor. Please allow 30 business days.

calls.subject: Client check-in: hand therapy
calls.body: Harold says the grip is getting better but he still cannot turn a wrench or open jars. Going to Ironleaf twice a week.

calls.subject: Client call: demand timing
calls.body: Harold asked when we will send the demand. Explained we are waiting on the surgery center's itemized bill and that we expect to demand the full policy. He understands.

pages.text:
PALISADE AMBULATORY SURGERY CENTER
OPERATIVE REPORT
Patient: BENBOW, HAROLD   DOB: 02/19/1962
Date of surgery: {{iso:-388}}
Surgeon: Naomi Fairweather, M.D.

Preoperative diagnosis: Displaced intra-articular fracture of the right distal radius (S52.571A).
Procedure: Open reduction and internal fixation of the right distal radius with volar locking plate and seven screws.
Anesthesia: General with regional block.
Findings: Dorsally angulated fracture with articular step-off of 3 mm, reduced anatomically under fluoroscopy.
Complications: None.
Plan: Splint for two weeks, then begin hand therapy. Hardware is expected to remain in place.

RIDGEWAY FRESH MARKET - CUSTOMER INCIDENT REPORT
Store #14, Yonkers
Date: {{iso:-415}}   Time: 11:20 AM
Location: Produce aisle 3, near banana display
Customer: Harold Benbow
Description: Customer slipped and fell on right side. Floor in aisle 3 was mopped at approx 11:10 AM by associate J. Castell after a spill. Wet floor sign: not placed (sign was in use at register 6).
Injury reported: Right wrist pain, possible deformity. EMS called 11:24 AM.
Completed by: D. Mirza, Assistant Store Manager
